name: Reading Nook
description: A snug corner off the main floor with two worn armchairs, a low table ringed with old mug stains, and a lamp with a crooked shade. The poetry shelf lives here — currently reorganised into a system only Dex fully understands. It's the quietest spot in the shop and the first place Iris sends anyone having a bad day.
example_text: Reading nook: two worn armchairs, a lamp with a crooked shade, the poetry shelf, a stained low table.

properties.lighting: soft and low, a single crooked-shade lamp
